functions.name: apply
functions.description: Registers the given CSS as an agent sheet for all chrome documents (replaces the previous one).

functions.name: setListFeatures
functions.description: Turns the message-list enhancements (sender initials, attachment preview) on or off. The library sources are passed in because moz-extension URLs are untrusted for loadSubScript.

functions.name: getAccounts
functions.description: Incoming servers with the key used in the folder tree (data-server-key).

functions.name: devMode
functions.description: Value of pref extensions.perch.devmode ('', 'selftest', 'options'); dev harness only.

functions.name: log
functions.description: Writes a line to stdout via dump(); for the dev harness.
